subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

The __sink__ is clogged due to solid materials.

options.text: A large fixed container to wash hands or utensils

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sink"** refers to a large, fixed container where water is supplied for washing hands, dishes, or utensils. (सिंक/नालीदार बर्तन धोने का स्थान)

 
 
• **Example:** The kitchen sink was filled with dirty dishes after the party.
 
 
 
• The correct meaning of "sink" in this context is a large container for washing, not its other meanings. (सिंक का सही मतलब यहां है: बर्तन धोने का बड़ा स्थान)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A pipeline for water supply** (पानी की आपूर्ति के लिए पाइपलाइन)

 
 
• **Example:** The pipeline burst due to high pressure, causing water leakage everywhere.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: A container which holds water** (एक कंटेनर जो पानी रखता है)
 
 
• **Example:** The bucket is a container that holds water for washing clothes.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To drown in water** (पानी में डूबना)
 
 
• **Example:** The boat capsized, and two passengers sank in the river.
